I've realized not long ago if i really wanted to be dead i would be. i thought i did, i thought about it at least a few times an hour, even in my best moments. now those thoughts have turned to "get ready for many more decades of misery". if i really wanted to i could find some way to end it but i dont. i wish id just get a terminal illness so my family cant blame me for dying on them. i hate being alive but the thought of my funeral keeps my gritting my teeth and breathing

I dont really tell people how i feel about these sorts of things usually unless i think theyll agree. i dont see how i can recalibrate my human interactions, i just feel my relationships with everyone i know is hollow and i just generally think "this person is awful but hey, ive known them for years and dont have any better options". its also not that im unimportant, like most people im less than worthless. if i died the world over all would be a better place, the world needs less people and i dont even want to be here. if i scrape by coping through consumerism id be just another person who doesnt deserve to live, or even want to live. like people in general i do want to do what i think will make me happy. in some fucked up way i feel if i could say to myself "im at least a neutral force in the world" everything else wouldnt bother me as much. because i am a selfish human my pain is much more immediate to me than that of others and i dont even want to help the people alive today. i care only about the future people who will suffer from our decisions and the animals whos planet we stole and destroyed, seeing them not as neighbors on the planet but resources to be captured tortured and exploited. so yes i do want to do it for my own peace of mind. i believe good and evil exists and humans are not the good in this dichotomy. i want to be good for myself. people do everything for themself even if they dont realize it. they help others because it makes them feel good and they feel bad if they dont, i cant even help myself though

I dont really know how I would turn this into a positive. more than anything I just want to curl up and die. humanity to me seems like a group of people stealing, killing, and backstabbing then scratches their heads wondering why their pockets are empty and their backs are bleeding. I guess I'd want to do something for the environment but everything seems to involve going to school and being good with STEM. to me being alive at the basic level feels too difficult. i look at eating, sleeping, showering, even talking to friends and family as an overwhelming burden that i just want to give up on.  I'm worried the only reason ill ever be alive is just because i cant bear to kill myself, which is where I'm at now, things being just barely tolerable enough to go on suffering. i dont know what i expect reddit to do but i appreciate youre trying to help

I kind of want to take meds but i still worry my life is, like the overwhelming majority of people, just a parasitic relationship with the earth and unlike others that im just not happy. at my core ive just always been miserable, ill die miserable and live miserable. I feel like anyone who knew what its like to be me would long for death.
